thread:
claire: Hey folks, I'm starting a tidy of the Quickstart onboarding (hello-minima). Goals: single-command local run, consistent env var names across examples, fix the SDK v9 link, and add a tiny /health smoke test. I'll open a draft PR under examples/hello-minima-refresh.

devin: Love it. For single-command, prefer `npm ci && npm run start` from repo root. Keep Docker option but make the npm path the easiest.

rachel: Agreed. Can we standardize on MINIMA_API_KEY as the env var? There's still confusion with OLD_TOKEN in legacy guides.

claire: Yes — using MINIMA_API_KEY. I'll add a Migration section: "If you previously used OLD_TOKEN, set MINIMA_API_KEY to its value or rename your CI secret."

devin: Also the current quickstart links to the old SDK path and 404s. Please point to https://sdk.redwood.ai/v9/quickstart and add docs CI linkcheck to the PR.

claire: Will do. Draft PR #5237 coming up. Checklist in PR: - add examples/hello-minima-refresh with start wrapper - include .env.sample - update README quick run steps - replace SDK link with v9 - add migration note for OLD_TOKEN - add docs CI linkcheck job - add examples/test/smoke.test.js asserting GET /health -> 200 - keep small Dockerfile stanza for on-prem users - update screenshot alt text for accessibility

docs-bot: Reminder: docs linter and linkcheck will run on PR. Broken links cause failure.

rachel: For reviewers: @devin please take CI/linkcheck, @claire handles code + README, I'll proof text and update screenshots.

claire: Start wrapper will prefer process.env over .env so CI secrets work. Small start.js snippet I'll include in PR: `require('dotenv').config(); const PORT = process.env.PORT||8080; /* simple server returning /health */`

devin: I'll add a CI job `docs:linkcheck` that runs after docs build and fails on 404. Also run the examples smoke test. I'll drop grep output into the PR to confirm no other OLD_TOKEN refs remain.

docs-bot: linkcheck queued on draft.

claire: Pushed initial changes, added .env.sample with MINIMA_API_KEY and MINIMA_REGION. Also left a short note about secret rotation: keep the secret name MINIMA_API_KEY in your CI.

docs-bot: linkcheck: external links OK. examples smoke: failing (pre-fix).

claire: Pushed fix for the health route path; re-run CI.

docs-bot: examples smoke: passing. linkcheck: OK.

rachel: Two tiny copy edits in the auth paragraph (prefer "token" in prose). Made and pushed.

devin: CI/ops LGTM. Once docs review approves, merge and we can announce in #announcements.

claire: Merged PR #5237. Will post short blurb after docs deploy. Thanks all!
